result:
I’d make a decent life less dependent on the circumstances of your birth.

Where you’re born, what your parents have, the body you arrive in—those things shape so much before you’ve had a chance to choose anything. I’d want them to have less power over whether you’re safe, whether you get care, whether you have room to become yourself.

Not a world where everyone lives the same life. A world where more people actually get to choose one.
